page_title: CloudGPU — GPU cloud and model APIs on one balance

sources.entry: CloudGPU - Per-minute GPU rental and an OpenAI-compatible model API, plus an MCP server that quotes a job and starts it only after confirmation. #paid #mcp #api

summary.name: CloudGPU
summary.one_liner: CloudGPU is a paid service that rents on-demand GPUs by the minute and serves chat, image, speech and transcription models through one OpenAI-compatible API, both billed from a single prepaid balance.
use_cases: rent a GPU by the minute for training or inference
host DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama or Mistral on a dedicated GPU
run ComfyUI or FLUX image workflows
call chat, image, speech or transcription models via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
let an AI agent quote and start a GPU job after approval
summary.what_it_does: CloudGPU rents on-demand GPUs such as the RTX 5090, RTX 4090 and A100, with root SSH and JupyterLab access and per-minute or hourly billing depending on configuration. It also offers 50 models across five modalities through per-token model APIs, reachable at a base URL of https://cloudgpu.app/v1 with a CloudGPU API key. The page lists an hourly price table from about $0.15/hr (RTX 2080) to $1.89/hr (H20-3e 141G). Both GPU rental and model APIs draw from one prepaid balance, topped up by card, Alipay, Google Pay, Apple Pay or USDT TRC-20. An MCP server lets an agent check task fit, show a quote and start a job only after the user approves.
notable: One prepaid balance covers both GPU rentals and per-token model APIs, with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint
MCP-based agent flow quotes a job and runs it only after user approval
Pay by USDT TRC-20, card, Alipay, Google Pay or Apple Pay; no egress fees per page
Root SSH, JupyterLab and template-based HTTP endpoints for model deployment
caveats: Public beta with no SLA: no uptime guarantee and no service credits
Destroying an instance erases its local disk; results must be saved or downloaded before destroying
Some configurations use hourly billing with a 1-hour minimum and no refund for unused time on voluntary stop
